scope: Separate review of current diff, caller/cache contract and completed test/benchmark evidence; no new model/OCR run.
decision: No proven new PDF-coordinate or formal per-pass/per-render budget defect found. Performance and regional coverage limitations must remain explicit.

budgets.time_limit_boundary: Timeout applies to each Tesseract subprocess. PDF render, PIL conversion, PNG encoding and word merging are outside it. Neither version promises a strict120-second total page wallclock deadline.

pixels.negative_control: Naive72dpi gives1001px at cap1000; corrected71dpi fits.

budgets.aggregate_work: Per-clip caps intentionally permit more total rendered/OCR pixels across four crops than the old single capped whole-page bitmap. No aggregate12MP page budget or constant CPU/heap claim is made. Rendering remains sequential.
budgets.enhancement: Existing identity/2xuniform enhancement is unchanged. Default12MP/4096 limits remain safe for its<1200px input condition; custom lower caps were already not enhancement-output caps.

coordinates.chain: Chosen overview quadrant -> inverse OCR rotation -> display PDF clip -> clipped pixmap -> undo enhancement/rotation locally -> actual pix.x/y origin ->72/DPI -> intrinsic page derotation once.
coordinates.layout: Display-PDF boxes separately return to the selected overview reading frame. Final crop-word PDF coordinates do not use the rounded overview-pixel interpolation.
coordinates.additional_render_experiment: For all4 intrinsic rotations with nonzeroCropBox, direct clip pixels equalled the corresponding region of the same-DPI full render.

performance_limitation.required_reporting: Record59.513→84.620seconds(+42.2%) andq4 timeout as known regression/coverage limitation. Correct rendering does not mean the pavilion label is recovered or all regions improve.
performance_limitation.recommendation: Save the narrow rendering correction with this limitation. Do not automatically increase pass/time budgets or add target-specificROIs.

validation.review_retests: None: no code changes since completed validation; verified current engineSHA equals benchmark engineSHA.
